verdict.gold_reason: Article 5(4) of Regulation 2019/943 states that for facilities commissioned from 1 January 2026, the point (b) derogation applies only to renewable installations below 200 kW. Article 5(2)(b) gives the 400 kW threshold for earlier plants. Both match the reference answer.

other_articles.why: Gives the same 200 kW threshold for facilities commissioned from 2026, but for priority dispatch, not exemption from balance responsibility.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question is phrased loosely ("green plant", "mismatches"), but it clearly points to the balance-responsibility derogation. Article 12(5) is a similar rule about a different subject.
